name: app-month-calendar-in-hand-on-tan-leather-sofa
title: Calendar with coloured dash markers held above a tan tufted sofa and navy trousers
whatItIs: A hand holds a tilted phone with a light-grey monthly calendar, day/week/month toggle, coloured dashes under dates, a black today circle and a tab bar with a blue selected pill, over a tan quilted sofa and navy trousers.
whatItMeans: Everyday and calm; the sofa scene sets the app in a relaxed evening moment.
techniques: Show the app in a relaxed lifestyle scene.
Match scene colours to the UI (tan, navy, blue).
Use a segmented control for views.

vocabulary.definition: A relaxed real-life setting for a mockup.
A coloured dash under a date.
The active tab shown as a coloured capsule.
